text:
incident-bot: 🔔 Paging: High tail latency & increased 5xx for tenant="borealis" (dedicated pool dp-43, vpc). Alerts: p95 latency > 3s, 5xx rate 2.8% (baseline 0.2%) — started 23:12 UTC.

maria: i’m on it. saw a spike in request queue depth on dp-43, looks like bespoke batching config might be letting massive batches form with long accumulation time.

aj: tagging me, will grab next. what's the current max_batch_tokens on borealis?

samir: config shows: ```
scheduler:
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  max_batch_size: 64
  batching_strategy: adaptive
  burst_capacity_tokens: 25000
```

priya: that's huge for their workload (many short queries). long waits while waiting to fill batches => tail latency. also seeing a KV cache miss spike.

maria: customer impact: borealis reported autocomplete lag in their UI, they confirmed increased error rate. estimated affected requests ~12k/minute. priority: P2 customer-facing latency.

incident-bot: incident created: INC-2026-23765. On-call: maria, aj.

aj: plan: 1) reduce max_batch_tokens and max_batch_size for tenant to favor latency 2) enable aggressive batch timeout (max_wait_ms=30) 3) temporarily lower burst_capacity_tokens 4) monitor for error change.

theo: +1. we should do this as a tenant-level override so other tenants unaffected. have infractl patch ready?

samir: prepared patch: ```bash
infractl tenant update --tenant borealis \
  --set scheduler.max_batch_tokens=1024 \
  --set scheduler.max_batch_size=16 \
  --set scheduler.max_wait_ms=30 \
  --set scheduler.burst_capacity_tokens=8000 \
  --notes "emergency latency mitigation 23:30 UTC"
```

maria: aj, can you apply and watch? i'll coordinate with borealis-sre and measure p95/p99.

aj: applying now. will push during low deploy pressure.

deploy-bot: starting tenant config update: borealis -> dp-43 (rollout id r-5862)

aj: applied the override, rollout started. patch id r-5862.

maria: seeing initial effect: p95 down from ~3.8s to ~1.5s within 30s. 5xx dropped to 1.1% (still above baseline). continuing to watch.

borealis-sre: thanks — we see UI responsiveness improving. still occasional spike on long requests though. any next steps?

samir: we should also enable prefix KV caching for their popular prompts to avoid regen cost. quick toggle: ```bash
infractl tenant update --tenant borealis --set cache.prefix.enabled=true --set cache.prefix.ttl_s=300
```

aj: toggled prefix cache. metrics: token CPU decreased, tail latency p99 trimming. 5xx now 0.35%.

priya: note for postmortem: bespoke large max_batch_tokens combined with adaptive batching & long wait_ms caused queue head-of-line accumulation for many short-requests workloads. dedicated pool + VPC meant failure surface was concentrated.

maria: customer update sent: "we applied temporary batching overrides and enabled caching; we're monitoring — please report if you see regressions." borealis acknowledged.

theo: i'm going to open a quick runbook change recommending tenant-workload profiling before large max_batch_tokens. also add an automated suggestion in Optimize for when p95>1s and average tokens<200 to recommend max_batch_tokens<=1024.

aj: handoff — i'm on for 30 more mins then off. @samir take over for longer-term follow-up and postmortem.

samir: taking handoff. i'll collect traces and create retrospective notes. initial blameless notes: tuning mismatch + missing workload signal for adaptive batching.

incident-bot: incident INC-2026-23765 status -> mitigated (23:46 UTC).

maria: final check at 23:55: p95 420ms, p99 1.1s, 5xx 0.12%. closing this thread, will attach config diffs and metric graphs to the postmortem.

borealis-sre: huge thanks to oncall team, appreciate the quick mitigation. :bow:
